 Data Scientist
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 As a Data Scientist, you’re excited at the prospect of unlocking the secrets held by a data set, and you’re fascinated by the possibilities presented by IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. In an increasingly connected world, massive amounts of structured and unstructured data open new opportunities. As a Data Scientist at Booz Allen, you can help turn these complex data sets into useful information to solve global challenges. Across private and public sectors—from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence—we need you to help find the answers in the data.
   

  

 As a Data Scientist specializing in intelligence data architecture, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing data management systems to support critical intelligence needs. You will leverage your expertise in data modeling, data architecture, and various database technologies to create efficient, scalable, and secure solutions. You will work with data sources and formats, ensuring data quality, integrity, and accessibility for advanced analytics and reporting. Your role will be pivotal in shaping the data landscape, enabling data\-driven decision\-making within the organization.
   

  

 Work with us as we use data science for good.
   

  

 Join us. The world can’t wait.

* Experience with cloud\-based data platforms, data lakes, and data warehouses
* Experience with building, optimizing, and monitoring end\-to\-end data pipelines, including ETL processes

* Knowledge of intelligence community data systems and workflows

* Ability to integrate web applications and data visualization frameworks for mission\-focused solutions

* Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines

* Competitive base salary (up to €100,000/yr) \+ performance bonuses

* Team Player: You collaborate effectively across disciplines, give and receive feedback constructively, and mentor others.

* Intro Call – 30 minutes with our team to align on fit and expectations
* Take\-Home Challenge – A practical task based on real\-world problems
* Technical Interview – Deep dive into the challenge, technical experience, and DevOps engineering

InteractiveAI is a fast\-growing startup on a mission to empower enterprises with fully managed AI agent lifecycles.

title: Data Engineer Azure
description:
We are looking for versatile **Python developers** to work on our IoT and data platform projects. Depending on the project, we work with scripts and small programmes for streaming processing, setting up APIs and backends with Django and Fast API, or processing data with Spark and other technologies.


The only thing that matters to us is **that you are passionate about Python, data and tinkering**.


100% of Galeo employees use Python in their day\-to\-day work; it is already part of the common stack for data engineers, data scientists, IoT engineers, systems engineers, web developers, etc.


### **Professional conditions**


Let’s be clear. At Galeo, we value our team and want to offer you the best conditions to develop your career in an environment that suits your needs:


* A competitive salary, complemented by an attractive performance\-based bonus.
* A training and professional development plan. All Galeo engineers have annual training and certification goals, which are personalised and designed in collaboration with the company.
* Real access to certifications: AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Confluent, Databricks, among others.
* An informal, flexible and friendly working environment. We work in small teams and offer a remote format adapted to your needs. We prioritise hiring in Asturias and the Canary Islands, although we will consider candidates from anywhere in Spain if their experience and value justify it.
* 23 days of holiday \+ Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve off \+ 2 months of intensive working hours in summer.
* Flexible hours and 2 long weekends to enjoy life more.
* Face\-to\-face events: we hold two annual face\-to\-face meetings with the whole team in a festive atmosphere.
* Innovative projects in key sectors: We specialise in areas such as Defence, Energy, Buildings, Transport, Hospitals, Industry and Infrastructure. We greatly value experience in these industries, so if this applies to you, we would love to meet you.
* Other financial incentives: Rewards for referring talent to Galeo or for coaching more junior colleagues. More than 70% of our employees come from internal referrals, which says a lot about how we work here!
* Techie atmosphere: we love keeping up with the latest technology.
* Close\-knit team and good vibes: we’re like a big family here.
* Trust and flexibility: we know that life isn’t just about work. If you need time for your family or yourself, you can arrange it without any hassle.
* We believe in diversity as a driver of innovation. We especially encourage women and underrepresented profiles in the technology sector to apply: your talent adds value and makes us better.


If you are looking for a place where your talent is valued, with opportunities for development and challenging projects, Galeo is for you. Join our team!


### **Roles and responsibilities**


These will be your main roles:


* Python development for real\-time projects
* Experience in developing services in **Azure**.
* Ability to integrate multiple services in **Azure** and build complex platforms.
* Use of tools such as **Databricks, Data Factory and Fabric**.

### **Professional skills**


We don’t expect you to know everything, we value what isn’t written here, and what matters to us is your ability to absorb new knowledge:


* 2 to 5 years’ experience as a Python developer
* Experience in public cloud, mainly Azure
* Experience with tools such as **Databricks, Data Factory and Fabric**.
* Basic knowledge of Docker is an advantage
* Experience with Terraform is an advantage
* Experience working with IoT or streaming data platforms is an advantage
* Knowledge of other programming and scripting languages is an advantage
* Essential: personality suited to working in a team and dealing directly with our customers. We work remotely, so communication with the rest of the world is essential for the formula to work.
* The most important thing is that you have experience in different technologies and are motivated to continue learning about each technological ecosystem.

### **Requirement**


We prioritise hiring in Asturias, although we will consider candidates from anywhere in Spain if their experience and value justify it.


### **Galeo Team**


The GALEO team is made up of a group of more than sixty professionals with extensive experience in various fields of technology, engineering, science and business. Our experience includes the creation and development of digital products, the application of artificial intelligence on a large scale, the construction of data platforms for large companies, the performance of scientific experiments, the design of IoT hardware and even the launch of several start\-ups.


At GALEO, we like to create things, and that is our focus. No nonsense, no paperwork, no bureaucracy and no ties. We pride ourselves on maintaining a free and independent spirit that allows us to provide maximum value to our clients in a direct, transparent and professional manner.


GALEO’s team of engineers, developers and architects works flexibly in small, multidisciplinary and autonomous teams, which operate in complete alignment to achieve our project objectives and satisfy our clients.


### **Selection process at GaleoTech**


We want you to get to know us as well as we want to get to know you, which is why our process is transparent, agile and human:


* Video call with our Head of People. *To get to know you, tell you more about Galeo and answer any questions you may have.*


* Technical demonstration/practical challenge. *Nothing too complex, just a small test so we can see how you work and give you space to shine.*

Apply directly using our form, sharing your CV and/or LinkedIn profile.


We look forward to meeting you!

description:

description:

BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. Síguenos en Instagram: @LifeAtBBVA y ¡conéctate el día 8!


¡Prepárate para descubrir todo lo que necesitas saber y dar el siguiente paso en tu carrera!


**¿Acabas de estudiar y estás buscando nuevas oportunidades?** 

El equipo de diseño de BBVA tiene la misión de diseñar como las personas, las empresas y las comunidades interactúan con sus finanzas hoy, acompañándolas para generar un impacto positivo mañana. Somos un equipo diverso formado por más de 50 profesionales del diseño UX/UI, diseño de servicios, diseño de contenidos e investigación para el diseño.


Si quieres unirte a nuestro equipo, te contamos cómo hacerlo.


Estamos buscando a futuros profesionales del diseño para incorporarse a nuestro equipo. Aquí tendrás la oportunidad de integrarte completamente en los proyectos y actividades, trabajando mano a mano con uno de los equipos más reconocidos en el sector.


Tendrás la oportunidad de formarte en diferentes roles y valorar tu interés de crecer en el que más te interese.


Las tareas generales incluirán el diseño , la investigación , el lanzamiento de nuevas iniciativas internas y el apoyo al trabajo de diseño en curso . Algunas iniciativas que lidera el equipo son: la definición de la experiencia en App (por ej: el lanzamiento de la nueva app en España), el mantenimiento del sistema de Diseño (BBVA Experience) o entender cómo acompañar a las empresas ante el reto de la descarbonización o qué oportunidades encontramos ante las nuevas dinámicas sociales.


Las personas participantes estarán acompañadas y mentorizadas por personas de nuestro equipo. Esta es una gran oportunidad para aprender y experimentar cómo se trabaja en uno de los equipos de diseño líderes en el sector.


Conoce más sobre BBVA aquí: https://www.bbva.com/es/


**About the job:**

**Qué ofrecemos:**

* Se trata de un contrato formativo para la obtención de la práctica profesional adecuada al nivel de estudios de **11 meses a jornada completa,** enfocado en tu desarrollo profesional en el área de diseño. No es un convenio universitario , sino un contrato laboral con objetivos formativos.
* Fecha de incorporación el **16 de enero de 2026** **, y fecha fin, el** **15 de diciembre de 2026\.**
* Desarrollarás tu rol desde las oficinas de la **Ciudad de BBVA, en Madrid** , con modalidad semipresencial : **formato híbrido de teletrabajo** (40% en remoto, al menos 60% presencial por trimestre), atendiendo a los requisitos pertinentes que se establezcan en cada momento por la entidad.
* Incorporarte a un equipo de Diseño de primer nivel, en el que adquirirás experiencia en proyectos de impacto y desarrollarás tu carrera como profesional del diseño.
* Itinerario formativo específico en Diseño que complementará tu experiencia académica.
* Ambiente colaborativo, donde tendrás oportunidad de trabajar en equipo y de estar integrado en la comunidad internacional de Diseño. Estarás siempre acompañado por un Mentor asignado antes de comenzar el programa (la figura del Mentor se trata de un profesional especializado en diseño que te irá mentorizando a lo largo del programa).

**¿Qué estamos buscando?**

**Requisitos formativos y comunes:**

* Tienes que contar con un **Grado Universitario en Diseño, Bellas Artes o similar** **.** En caso de que hayas cursado un Grado Universitario en otro ámbito, será necesario que aportes un Máster o formación especializada en Diseño. Este título debe ser oficial u homologado en España .
* Tienes que haber finalizado tu formación en Diseño (Grado o Máster) en una **fecha comprendida entre Enero de 2023 y Octubre de 2025\.**
* Es imprescindible que **no hayas trabajado previamente con un contrato formativo para la obtención de la práctica profesional** (modelo de contrato 420\) en otra compañía con la misma titulación.
* No es necesario que cuentes con experiencia profesional previa.
* Buena capacidad para trabajar en equipo y conceptualizar ideas complejas.
* Buena capacidad de comunicación escrita y verbal en español y inglés (nivel de español mínimo: C1, nivel de inglés mínimo: B2\).
* Será requisito indispensable el estar en posesión del correspondiente permiso de residencia y trabajo para suscribir el contrato de trabajo con BBVA en España.

**Requisitos deseables de diseño:** 

* Conocimiento de fundamentos de interacción y usabilidad.
* Conocimiento en el uso de técnicas de diseño de servicios: definición de la propuesta de valor, mapeo del usuario, *blueprinting* , etc.
* Conocimiento en investigación cualitativa y en la realización de trabajo de campo: observaciones contextuales, entrevistas, grupos de discusión, etc.
* Capacidad para la composición y la utilización de recursos visuales.
* Conocimiento de Figma u otras herramientas de prototipado.

**Cómo participar en el proceso:**

* Es necesario que **adjuntes** **un documento PDF** **que incluya tu** **CV** **junto con una** **selección de 3 trabajos de diseño** (académicos o profesionales). La extensión del documento no puede ser mayor de 10 páginas. Debes adjuntarlo en el momento de la aplicación al Programa, en la misma herramienta (workday).
* Importante : solo se tendrán en cuenta aquellas candidaturas que adjunten la documentación solicitada . (CV \+ Portafolio).

**Línea de tiempo del proceso:**

* Recepción de candidaturas, pruebas psicotécnicas y de inglés (del 1/10/2025 al 20/10/2025\)
* Desarrollo de un reto práctico de diseño (del 31/10/2025 al 3/11/2025\)

* Sesión virtual de bienvenida (15/12/2025\)
* Inicio del programa (16/01/2026\)
* Fin del programa (15/12/2026\)
* Fecha límite de inscripción: 20 de octubre de 2025\.

Para que estos proyectos sean posibles, será imprescindible cuestionar y rediseñar elementos clave del modelo de ejecución convencional: desde los marcos de compliance y gestión de riesgos, hasta los entornos de testing, gobierno del dato y procesos de toma de decisiones.


Por tanto, este rol no se limita a ejecutar proyectos de IA sino para ello debe identificar los elementos a modificar en el modelo de ejecución y promover, en colaboración con las áreas del banco que corresponda, su adaptación para hacer viables este tipo de proyectos.

=========================

* Liderar la ejecución de proyectos transformacionales de alto impacto, que incorporen capacidades de inteligencia artificial, automatización y análisis avanzado de datos, con un enfoque estratégico y disruptivo.

* Conectar el diseño de soluciones de IA con el delivery efectivo, asegurando que el enfoque técnico (algoritmos, modelos, datos) se traduce en resultados a nivel negocio.
* Plantear hipótesis, validar y descartar rápidamente
* Definir e impulsar pilotos transformacionales, identificando aprendizajes rápidos ("fail fast")
* Promover la cultura de experimentación, aprendizaje continuo y adopción responsable de la IA.
* Desarrollar y mantener relaciones efectivas con los stakeholders de negocio para los proyectos identificados, definiendo conjuntamente las hipótesis a testar y criterios de éxito de los proyectos
* Definir el Roadmap, establecer y priorizar el backlog y monitorizar la ejecución de los proyectos bajo su responsabilidad

**Requisitos**
==============

* Experiencia sólida superior a 7 años en proyectos de transformación, incluyendo al menos 3 en entornos de innovación con IA o Data.
* Capacidad para facilitar y co\-diseñar marcos organizativos en colaboración con las áreas implicadas.
* Dominio de metodologías ágiles y experiencia en la ejecución de pilotos disruptivos o experimentales, en colaboración con equipos de negocio y tecnología.
* Alta capacidad para alinear intereses entre múltiples stakeholders, incluyendo áreas de cumplimiento, riesgo, legal, negocio y tecnología.
* Mentalidad innovadora y desafiante, combinada con criterio de negocio y visión sistémica.
* Actitud proactiva y orientación a resultados, con capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a entornos cambiantes y retos de alta complejidad.
* Valorable tener conocimiento de la organización BBVA, en especial en los ámbitos de Commercial, CIB \& Sustainability
* Experiencia en AI aplicada a soluciones empresariales y conocimiento de las tendencias actuales en Machine Learning y análisis avanzado.
* Fluidez en inglés (nivel C1\) y español, con excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita y oral.

**Job title:** Data Scientist in AI for Cardiology – Digital Health Unit (RE1\)  

  

**About BSC**  

  

The Barcelona Supercomputing Center \- Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC\-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain. It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large\-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe. The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress. BSC combines HPC service provision and R\&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over 1000 staff from 60 countries.  

  

Look at the BSC experience:  

BSC\-CNS YouTube Channel  

Let's stay connected with BSC Folks!  

  

We are particularly interested for this role in the strengths and lived experiences of women and underrepresented groups to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights in science and IT research. In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under\-represented sex will be favoured.  

  

We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences.
  

  

If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer. We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team.  

  

**Context And Mission**  

  

The Barcelona Supercomputing Center – Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC\-CNS) is Europe’s leading center for supercomputing research. The successful candidate will work in a highly sophisticated HPC environment, have access to state\-of\-the\-art systems and computational infrastructures, and establish collaborations with experts and companies in different areas at the local and international levels.  

  

The Digital Health Unit, led by Dr. Paula Petrone, applies artificial intelligence to healthcare with the goal of delivering innovative solutions that make a true impact for patients.  

  

This position is part of a collaboration with the AI in Cardiology Group at Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau (Drs. Martin Descalzo \& Matias Calandrelli). The aim is to develop AI solutions in cardiology that advance healthcare practice and contribute to product\-oriented applications with real\-world clinical impact.  

We encourage applications from all genders and candidates from underrepresented groups.  

  

**Key Duties**  

  

* Develop AI models for cardiology, with emphasis on:  

	+ Analysis of cardiac signals using advanced signal processing methods
	+ Medical image analysis in cardiology
	+ Integration of biomarkers into predictive models
	+ Application of deep learning, transformers, foundational models, and generative AI approaches
* Collaborate with clinical researchers and cardiologists to co\-design and validate AI tools.
* Contribute to the development of product\-ready applications for use in healthcare settings.
* Ensure models are robust, explainable, and clinically relevant.
* Publish and disseminate results in scientific and innovation forums.
  

  

**Requirements**  

  

* Education
	+ Master’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or related fields.
	+ PhD is welcome (plus), but not required.
* Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience
	+ Hands\-on experience in deep learning applied to biomedical data, with emphasis on deep\-learning, transformers and foundational models.
	+ Strong background in signal processing, particularly for biomedical signals such as cardiac data.
	+ Proven expertise in medical image analysis, preferably in cardiology or related healthcare domains.
	+ Solid programming skills (Python or similar) and use of deep learning libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow).
	+ Strong interest in developing healthcare applications with real clinical impact.
* Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience
	+ Experience collaborating with clinical partners or working on healthcare datasets is an advantage.
	+ Familiarity with biomarkers or multimodal data integration is desirable.
* Competences
	+ Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
	+ Ability to collaborate in multidisciplinary teams (engineers, clinicians, researchers).
	+ Fluency in English, Catalan, and Spanish.

  

**Conditions**  

  

* The position will be located at BSC within the Life Sciences Department
* We offer a full\-time contract (37\.5h/week), a good working environment, a highly stimulating environment with state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure, flexible working hours, extensive training plan, restaurant tickets, private health insurance, support to the relocation procedures
* Duration: Open\-ended contract due to technical and scientific activities linked to the project and budget duration
* Holidays: 23 paid vacation days plus 24th and 31st of December per our collective agreement
* Salary: we offer a competitive salary commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate and according to the cost of living in Barcelona
* Starting date: asap
  

  

**Applications procedure and process**  

  

All applications must be submitted via the BSC website and contain:  

  

* A full CV in English including contact details
* A cover/motivation letter with a statement of interest in English, clearly specifying for which specific area and topics the applicant wishes to be considered. Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included. Applications without this document will not be considered.

  

**Development of the recruitment process**

  

The selection will be carried out through a competitive examination system ("Concurso\-Oposición"). The recruitment process consists of two phases:  

  

* **Curriculum Analysis:** Evaluation of previous experience and/or scientific history, degree, training, and other professional information relevant to the position. \- ***40 points***
* **Interview phase:** The highest\-rated candidates at the curriculum level will be invited to the interview phase, conducted by the corresponding department and Human Resources. In this phase, technical competencies, knowledge, skills, and professional experience related to the position, as well as the required personal competencies, will be evaluated. \- ***60 points.*** *A minimum of 30 points out of 60 must be obtained to be eligible for the position.*

  

The recruitment panel will be composed of at least three people, ensuring at least 25% representation of women.

  

In accordance with OTM\-R principles, a gender\-balanced recruitment panel is formed for each vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will begin the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. At a minimum, a personality questionnaire as well as a technical exercise will be conducted during the process.

  

The panel will make a final decision, and all individuals who participated in the interview phase will receive feedback with details on the acceptance or rejection of their profile.

  



  

  

At BSC, we seek continuous improvement in our recruitment processes. For any suggestions or comments/complaints about our recruitment processes, please contact recruitment \[at] bsc \[dot] es.  

For more information, please follow this link.

  

  

**Deadline**  

  

The vacancy will remain open until a suitable candidate has been hired. Applications will be regularly reviewed and potential candidates will be contacted.  

  

**OTM\-R principles for selection processes**  

  

BSC\-CNS is committed to the principles of the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers of the European Commission and the Open, Transparent and Merit\-based Recruitment principles (OTM\-R). This is applied for any potential candidate in all our processes, for example by creating gender\-balanced recruitment panels and recognizing career breaks etc.  

BSC\-CNS is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. Job position: Sr. Knowledge Engineer


Area: Diagnostics \- Roche Information Solutions (RIS)


Department: Data, Analytics and Research, Data Science Technologies

Location: Sant Cugat del Vallès


At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives and we are fearless in both decision and action \- we believe that good business means a better world. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.


As part of the larger Data, Analytics \& Research function within Roche Information Solutions, you serve as a source of best practices/quality and work independently within broad guidelines and policies, needing guidance in only the most complex situations. You are responsible for leading substreams and/or you participate in cross\-functional project teams to solve complex problems by using analytical thinking, tools and judgment to identify innovative solutions for Diagnostics. You seek feedback from all stakeholders and colleagues regularly and adapt your behavior quickly. You live the operating principles and follow the guidelines of making impact now and thinking long\-term in your daily work.


As Sr. Knowledge Engineer, you have a specialized depth and/or breadth of knowledge of FAIR, (semantic) data interoperability, healthcare ontologies, data models, terminologies and standards across digital products and systems within Diagnostics. You develop new approaches to complex problems pertinent to interoperability and standardization in healthcare. As a result, you may influence others to change their point of view and you may lead them to solve the problem.


Sr. Knowledge Engineer will also be responsible for leading the design and implementation of the data assets to support the transactional operations and the massive data processing (Big Data) to support use cases in Roche Diagnostics. He/she will be in charge of improving and auditing the data architecture, carrying out data governance functions, so that FAIR and data quality standards are ensured.

**Job Purpose:**

* You will be responsible for the interoperability enablement of RIS product portfolio by reusing, designing, implementing and maintaining data models (e.g. One Roche Data Model). You will ensure that these data models are aligned with the health data standards and policies defined.

* You will make sure robust data models and data access are available, and the information is correctly stored to enable the clinical and diagnostic use cases across RIS product portfolio on the data platform.

* You will design and develop domain data models based on the HL7 FHIR interoperability standard.

* You will work with Data Engineers, Software Engineers, Data Scientists, System Architects, Product Owners, Product Managers and guide them with their data needs and requirements.

For example, design and model the One Roche Data Model for the data assets at conceptual and logical level, supporting the use cases.
* Collaborate with engineering and business teams and co\-drive projects to implement interoperability standards for Roche devices and digital products adhering to FAIR principles.
* Support the design, implementation and evolution of the Roche Diabetes Care Platform Data Stores (physical data model) to ensure that all products are aligned with logical data models and coding standards. Work in cooperation with the system architect and development team members.
* Investigate innovative methods to generate new business insights from interlinked data sources (lab and clinical) that may mature into new features of RIS digital products.
* Drive the adoption and integration of interoperability standards including terminological resources (e.g. FHIR, HL7v2, LOINC, SNOMED) for RIS digital products.
* Engage with internal key customers and stakeholders to understand their business needs, pain points using a customer\-centric approach.
* Co\-create robust solutions starting out from prototypes and MVPs.
* Drive automation of data and software services to achieve continuous delivery e.g. by setting up code repositories, automation pipelines, quality assurance, etc.
* Supports and collaborates in the definition of the mapping to transform the data model into clinical interfaces, choosing the proper clinical standard and terminology to use.
* Maintains the data catalog well documented, updated and accessible for the different stakeholders.
* Defines the data quality processes \& rules, data quality metrics and ensures quality is met
* Deliver effective training and communication on the data standards to multiple levels of stakeholders.

**Key skills and Experience:**


Required:

* BS degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Math or other quantitative field.
* 5\+ years relevant experience
* 2\+ years of proven experience in data modeling, data architecting and databases storage design.
* Experience in HL7 / HL7 FHIR mandatory.
* Experience working with GitLab, JIRA and Confluence
* Experience in IOT, Data platforms and Data Hubs.
* Experience and good knowledge in web services architecture
* Experience managing globally distributed teams and 3rd party relationships
* Good understanding of SCRUM methodology
* Ability to work in a fast paced and changing environment
* Independent judgment and decision\-making ability
* Good communication skills and excellent team collaboration
* Fluent in English (required)

**Preferred:**

* Experience in Amazon Web Services or Cloud technologies
* Experience generating implementation guides for developers, clients and customers.
* Experience in micro services, integration, cloud and bigdata architectures, especially on AWS.
* Experience codifying clinical concepts with clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, LOINC, UCUM, ICD9, ICD10\).
* Experience modelling healthcare interfaces using standards (HL7 v2\.x, HL7 FHIR, DICOM).
* DAMABook certification

  

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

  

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

**About BSC**
 The Barcelona Supercomputing Center \- Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC\-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain. It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large\-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe. The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress. BSC combines HPC service provision and R\&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over 1000 staff from 60 countries.
   

  

**Look At The BSC Experience**
 BSC\-CNS YouTube Channel
   

  

 Let's stay connected with BSC Folks!

In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under\-represented sex will be favoured.
   

  

 We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences.
   

  

 If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer. We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team.
   

  

**Context And Mission**
 The Barcelona Supercomputing Center – Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC\-CNS) is Europe’s leading center for supercomputing research. The successful candidate will work in a highly sophisticated HPC environment, have access to state\-of\-the\-art systems and computational infrastructures, and establish collaborations with experts and companies in different areas at the local and international levels.
   

  

 The Digital Health Unit, led by Dr. Paula Petrone, applies artificial intelligence to healthcare with the goal of delivering innovative solutions that make a true impact for patients.
   

  

 This position is part of a collaboration with the AI in Cardiology Group at Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau (Drs. Martin Descalzo \& Matias Calandrelli). The aim is to develop AI solutions in cardiology that advance healthcare practice and contribute to product\-oriented applications with real\-world clinical impact.
   

  

 We encourage applications from all genders and candidates from underrepresented groups.
   

  

**Key Duties**
* Develop AI models for cardiology, with emphasis on:
* Analysis of cardiac signals using advanced signal processing methods
* Medical image analysis in cardiology
* Integration of biomarkers into predictive models
* Application of deep learning, transformers, foundational models, and generative AI approaches
* Collaborate with clinical researchers and cardiologists to co\-design and validate AI tools.
* Contribute to the development of product\-ready applications for use in healthcare settings.
* Ensure models are robust, explainable, and clinically relevant.
* Publish and disseminate results in scientific and innovation forums.


**Requirements**
* Education
+ Master’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or related fields.
+ PhD is welcome (plus), but not required.

* Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience
+ Hands\-on experience in deep learning applied to biomedical data, with emphasis on deep\-learning, transformers and foundational models.
+ Strong background in signal processing, particularly for biomedical signals such as cardiac data.
+ Proven expertise in medical image analysis, preferably in cardiology or related healthcare domains.
+ Solid programming skills (Python or similar) and use of deep learning libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow).
+ Strong interest in developing healthcare applications with real clinical impact.

* Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience
+ Experience collaborating with clinical partners or working on healthcare datasets is an advantage.
+ Familiarity with biomarkers or multimodal data integration is desirable.

* Competences
+ Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
+ Ability to collaborate in multidisciplinary teams (engineers, clinicians, researchers).
+ Fluency in English, Catalan, and Spanish.


**Conditions**
* The position will be located at BSC within the Life Sciences Department
* We offer a full\-time contract (37\.5h/week), a good working environment, a highly stimulating environment with state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure, flexible working hours, extensive training plan, restaurant tickets, private health insurance, support to the relocation procedures
* Duration: Open\-ended contract due to technical and scientific activities linked to the project and budget duration
* Holidays: 23 paid vacation days plus 24th and 31st of December per our collective agreement
* Salary: we offer a competitive salary commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate and according to the cost of living in Barcelona
* Starting date: asap

 All applications must be submitted via the BSC website and contain:
   

  

* A full CV in English including contact details
* A cover/motivation letter with a statement of interest in English, clearly specifying for which specific area and topics the applicant wishes to be considered. Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included. Applications without this document will not be considered.


**Development of the recruitment process**
 The selection will be carried out through a competitive examination system ("Concurso\-Oposición"). The recruitment process consists of two phases:
   

  

* Curriculum Analysis: Evaluation of previous experience and/or scientific history, degree, training, and other professional information relevant to the position. \- 40 points
* Interview phase: The highest\-rated candidates at the curriculum level will be invited to the interview phase, conducted by the corresponding department and Human Resources. In this phase, technical competencies, knowledge, skills, and professional experience related to the position, as well as the required personal competencies, will be evaluated. \- 60 points. A minimum of 30 points out of 60 must be obtained to be eligible for the position.


 The recruitment panel will be composed of at least three people, ensuring at least 25% representation of women.
   

  

 In accordance with OTM\-R principles, a gender\-balanced recruitment panel is formed for each vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will begin the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. title: Trustworthy AI Data Scientist
company: Centre Tecnològic de la Química a Catalunya
description:
EURECAT
   

  

 Eurecat is the second Research \& Technology Organisation in Spain and one of the largest applied research and technology transfer organisation in Southern
   

  

 Europe. It brings together the experience of more than 800 professionals who generate an annual turnover of 69 million euros and provides services to more than 2,000 companies. Eurecat integrates advanced digital capabilities and experience in biotechnology, industry and sustainability and collaborates with industry in R\+D\+I activities and projects, offering advanced scientific and technological services and specialized knowledge to respond effectively to the technological needs of very different business sectors, accelerating innovation, reducing both risks and spendings on scientific and technological infrastructures. The technology center participates in more than 200 large national and international consortium projects of high strategic R\&I, has 230 patents and 10 spin\-offs. Eurecat has eleven centers in Catalonia and presence in Madrid, Malaga and Chile.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
 You will join the Trustworthy AI team, a tight group of researchers and developers working on cutting\-edge projects in the fields of explainable AI, AI compliance, data quality and data value for data markets and data spaces. We’d love for a smart, curious person, who can dive into a diversity of topics and efficiently translate research outputs into AI and data prototypes or products.
   

  

**Who we are?**
 The Big Data \& Data Science Unit takes part in R\&D projects covering a diversity of domains for stakeholders in Europe, Spain and Catalunya. We believe that the benefits of AI and data should be fairly distributed among contributing individuals and believe in the social impact of what we do. We develop domain\-agnostic technology, meaning that we’re a curious bunch, we value a research mindset and have to be able to quickly, but reliably prototype our ideas. Cooperation is chief amongst us and the expertise of one member quickly diffuses through the team, such that the others can benefit from it as well.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Analyse project requirements and identify research directions.
* Research the state of the art, synthesise findings, identify research and technology gaps.
* Conceptualise, design and implement AI and data solutions.
* Communicate your results with the team and project stakeholders. If interested, join us in writing papers and presenting them in relevant venues.
* Participate in writing project proposals \- this is an opportunity to target projects and areas that we’re passionate about and seek funding.


**Details**
 This is a full\-time position, in our Barcelona offices or any of our other local offices (Corporate offices of Eurecat in the territory).
   

  

 The team works partly remote (2 days/week at the office).
   

  

**To apply**
 Be sure to include links to your portfolio of projects (your Git page, links to projects you’ve developed and deployed, …) or scientific papers.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Must\-haves in a candidate**
* Passion for data and AI, with the added motivation for fair and trustworthy technology.
* Experience in at least one of: explainable/interpretable AI, bias assessment, privacy enhancing technologies, AI/Data compliance.
* You tick at least one of the following boxes:
* Strong background in data science, Machine/Deep Learning, software development


 OR
   

  

* MSc in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Bioinformatics, or similar field


 OR
   

  

* Convincing portfolio of data science projects sharable on Git
* You code: Python, R, Java, whatever you feel comfortable with. We appreciate clean and readable code, following coding standards.
* You can manage and query both SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Write grant proposals to fund the work that matters to us. From smaller, local project, to top\-grade, multi\-national European consortia.


**Nice to Have**
* Prior experience with any of the following: data governance, data value, data markets, ontologies, knowledge management.
* Experience with any of: Generative AI, Neurosymbolic AI, Federated Learning
* MLOps \- You know how to develop and test AI pipelines, from data ingestion, processing, to model development and evaluation.
* Extra points if you have already been exposed to Data Spaces.

* Experience in scientific programming and data analysis

* Experience communicating with experts and non\-experts on scientific problems and results

title: SENIOR DATA SCIENTIST
description:
En Mango vestimos de pasión todo lo que hacemos. Con origen en Barcelona y presencia en más de 120 países, inspiramos al mundo con creatividad, innovación y autenticidad.
   

  

 Nuestro equipo multicultural es el motor de nuestro éxito. Nos enorgullece llevar la moda más allá, conectando nuestro estilo único con personas de todo el mundo.
   

  

 Estamos buscando un/a Senior Data Scientist para unirse a nuestro equipo de Data\&Advanced Analytics.
   

  

 Formarás parte del equipo que da forma a la inteligencia, estrategia y arquitectura de datos de Mango. El equipo de Advanced Analytics desarrolla algoritmos de Inteligencia Artificial dirigidos a optimizar los procesos y decisiones más desafiantes dentro de la industria del retail.
   

  

 El equipo de Advanced Analytics de Mango está formado por Data Scientists, Big Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Deep Learning Researchers y Software Engineers que trabajan juntos en squads multidisciplinares para desarrollar algoritmos de aprendizaje automático de calidad de vanguardia aprovechando la última tecnología en plataformas de Big Data y computación distribuida.
   

  

 Cada Uno De Los Squads De Análisis Avanzado Tiene Como Objetivo Desarrollar y Evolucionar Algoritmos Para Hacer Frente a Algunos De Los Principales Retos Técnicos y Empresariales De Mango
   

  

* Personalization Squad: Equipo al que se incorporará la persona seleccionada y que es responsable de desarrollar algoritmos de Inteligencia Artificial para proporcionar una experiencia personalizada a los clientes de Mango, tanto en el sitio web y la app como en las comunicaciones por email. Aprovechando el gran volumen de datos de compras y de navegación de los clientes, los algoritmos desarrollados incluyen recomendaciones de productos, segmentaciones de clientes, un asistente conversacional de IA que actúa como asesor de moda para nuestros clientes o la generación de contenido personalizado mediante IA generativa, asegurando su despliegue en tiempo real.
* Generative Artificial Intelligence squad: Impulsar iniciativas innovadoras relacionadas con algoritmos generativos (texto, imagen, video, etc). Este squad ha liderado el desarrollo de la plataforma de IA basada en LLM para los casos de uso internos. Además, es responsable de impulsar la transformación que se está llevando a cabo en los procesos creativos empleando modelos de IA de generación de imágenes.
* Pricing and Mark\-Down Squad: Desarrollar algoritmos de aprendizaje automático que determinen las promociones y descuentos óptimos para optimizar el margen de la empresa durante el periodo de ventas.
* Purchasing/Production Squad: Desarrollar algoritmos de ciencia de datos para la detección temprana de best\-sellers y para determinar cuántas unidades de cada producto y talla debe fabricar Mango durante la planificación de la temporada.


 Debido a la relevancia de los proyectos de Mango Advanced Analytics, cada squad tiene visibilidad y presentaciones a nivel de junta directiva.
   

  

**SOBRE MANGO**
 En Mango nos inspira y une nuestra pasión por el estilo y la cultura. Estamos presentes en 118 países y nuestra presencia online se extiende a más de 80 países. Nuestro equipo está formado por personas de 112 nacionalidades, de las cuales el 80% son mujeres.
   

  

 Somos un equipo muy dinámico, motivado por las nuevas tecnologías, con pasión por lo que hacemos y ganas de asumir grandes retos que nos permitan seguir creciendo y aportando valor a través de los datos.
   

  

**TU NUEVO ROL**
 Como Senior Data Scientist formarás parte del equipo que da forma a la inteligencia, estrategia y arquitectura de datos de Mango. Trabajarás desarrollando soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial desarrolladas con modelos de datos y algoritmos de última generación. Estos productos de datos permiten casos de uso muy innovadores en el espacio del retail, como la geoanalítica, la robotización, la personalización omnicanal, la tienda conectada, la visión por ordenador, el consumidor 360º y las decisiones en tiempo real.
   

  

 En tu día a día…
   

  

* Realizarás el desarrollo de algoritmos avanzados de aprendizaje automático e inteligencia artificial para mejorar nuestros procesos y decisiones comerciales principales.
* Trabajarás con un sólido enfoque de ingeniería (por ejemplo, integración continua, automatización de pruebas, etc.) en un sólido equipo de ingenieros de datos y científicos de datos.
* Utilizarás Spark para escalar tus modelos y aprovecharás las herramientas de MLOps para desplegarlos en producción.
* Interactuarás con las partes interesadas del negocio para asegurar la alineación y la adopción adecuadas; y participarás en la entrega del proyecto de principio a fin.
* Trabajarás con un enfoque rápido e iterativo en nuevas ideas y pruebas de conceptos.
* Estarás conectado a los últimos desarrollos en Data Science y MLOps e invertirás tiempo en traer nuevas tecnologías y mejores prácticas a Mango.

* Al menos 4 años de experiencia como Data Scientist.

* Al menos 4 años de experiencia desarrollando en Python, u otro lenguaje orientado a objetos.

title: HDRC Research Data Scientist
description:
Job description


**Research Data Scientist for the National Institute of Health and Care Research (NIHR) Health Determinants Research Collaboration (HDRC) Ealing**



Ealing is a highly diverse and vibrant borough in West London. Home to around 386,000 people, it is the third largest borough by population in London and is an exciting place to live and work. There are stark and longstanding inequities in health determinants – the ‘building blocks’ of health – like education, social connection, housing, and good jobs. This leads to poorer health and shorter lives for disadvantaged communities.



To help address this, the council is one of four London boroughs to be awarded £5 million from the National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR) to create the NIHR Health Determinants Research Collaboration Ealing. This will enable us to have the capacity and infrastructure to do meaningful research on the health determinants in Ealing, learning together how to promote more healthy, thriving and equitable communities.



As a partnership with local community organisations, Golden Opportunities for Skills and Development, Ealing and Hounslow Community and Voluntary Service, and Southall Community Alliance, and research institutions London School of Hygiene \& Tropical Medicine, Imperial College London, and the Institute of Development Studies, the HDRC Ealing will bring a new approach to collecting and learning from data and insights on the building blocks of health, with stronger community participation and involvement in research.



HDRC Ealing values and promotes diverse forms of knowledge, participatory and action\-orientated approaches, systems thinking and pragmatic research that is responsive to the needs of staff and residents.



We are looking for an exceptional candidate who has the expertise and passion to drive forward this exciting programme of work.


**This research data science role will be responsible for:**



Leading research data analysis and data science work needed to enable the council to curate and manage timely and meaningful rigorous quantitative and mixed method research on the ‘building blocks of health’ (the conditions of life that impact how well and how long we live, for example, housing, employment, social connection, education, otherwise known as health determinants). You will work closely with council staff, academic and community partners.


**Success would be:**


* Successful delivery of high\-quality statistical analysis of quantitative data as part of research and evaluation on the building blocks of health in Ealing
* Successful applications for further research funding
* Successful engagement and take up of statistical analysis and quantitative data interpretation and synthesis training and capacity building in the Council.
* Signs of culture change in Ealing Council towards greater and systematic use of research data to inform action.


Collaboration is at the heart of this programme and you will be working closely with council departments, academic and community partners, considering ways to promote knowledge and skills exchange. This role offers a great learning opportunity in organisational capacity development and influencing culture change across diverse sectors.



There has never been a better time to join the team at Ealing to work on health equity.


* The Council Plan has a strong focus on tackling inequalities and is supporting a vision of ‘connected communities’
* Our new Health \& Wellbeing Strategy 2023\-2028 is focused on tackling inequalities through the building blocks of health
* We are 1 of 30 NIHR Health Determinants Research Collaborations across the country, and 1 in 4 in London.


By joining Ealing, you will be part of a respected, innovative and diverse London borough, committed to promoting health equity through stronger evidence use and creation.



Currently, the majority of staff are hybrid working, with 2 days a week attendance required in Perceval House and 3 days virtually from home (this may change depending on the needs of the collaboration and council).



For a discussion in confidence, please contact Rosie Rowe HDRC@ealing.gov.uk using ‘HDRC Research Data Scientist’ in your email heading.



You must have the right to work in the UK.



It is an exciting time to join us, here at Ealing Council. If you would like to make a positive difference to our residents and borough, then we are looking forward to hearing from you.



We have tried to make this website as accessible as possible. You can use the accessibility widget on the right\-hand side to make it more accessible to you and your needs.



Ealing Council is committed to creating good jobs and delivering on its connected communities’ agenda. We are committed to equality of opportunity, to being fair and inclusive.



Please note all applications will be determined on merit.



This post is subject to Ealing’s enhanced vetting process.

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely.  

Get to Know Us
Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity\-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting\-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future.
Senior Product Data Scientist
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Product Data Scientist, you will support the Product organization to take data driven decisions. You will work on complex and never before explored problems delivering insight on unique and interesting datasets. This role is a hands\-on delivery\-oriented role by owning one of the key deliveries workstreams. We work in an Agile environment where we are constantly learning and exchanging ideas.
The Team/Projects You will be working on:
The Biometrics team ensures that the selfies and video clips that users submit feature real humans. You will have the opportunity to work on Biometric Projects ranging from improving the SDK experience to detecting deep fakes.

* Work in partnership with product managers, applied scientists and engineers to define, measure, and communicate product metrics
* Act as a mentor for junior Product Data Scientists, providing guidance on their development, and supporting and reviewing delivery when needed.
* Ensure alignment in analytical delivery between Product, R\&D, and Analytics Engineering Team

title: Data Scientist, Quantitative Strategies (Asset & Wealth Management)
description:
We’re a pan\-European digital wealth manager with 130,000 active investors (growing fast!) and over €5 billion invested on our platform. With 220\+ people across 4 offices in Italy and the UK, we’re supported and funded by Poste Italiane, Cabot Square Capital, United Ventures and Allianz. We started in 2011 in Milan with a simple vision \- to help more people improve their financial well\-being by making personal investing straightforward and accessible through technology. Fast forward a few years, and we’re known as one of the most innovative fintechs headquartered in the heart of London.

**Mission**


To provide investment solutions and advice to protect and grow client wealth through time.

**Our Core Values:**


We’ve built our business on three Principles:

* Relationships are our first asset: We’re one team, built on trust, honesty and transparency. We value our relationships above all else.
* Trust drives success: We give each other the space to grow. We empower our employees to succeed, so they can make a real impact.
* Our customers dream big, just like us: We see the bigger picture and we make sure our customers see it, too. We’re always focused on the best outcomes for our clients and for each other, no matter what the goal, or how big the dream

**What this means in practice:**


At Moneyfarm, diversity is the foundation of our competitive advantage. We value our employees for who they are – their backgrounds, experiences, talents, knowledge and individual differences. This is what makes us better at what we do. To accommodate our different needs and commitments, we offer flexible working to all. Our individual impact and output is what counts most.

**About the role:**


We are seeking a bright and motivated Investments Data Scientist to join our dynamic Investment Team. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your career and apply your quantitative skills to real\-world investment challenges. You will support senior team members in designing, developing, and deploying sophisticated models that influence investment decisions.


This position is ideal for a candidate with a strong foundational understanding of modern quantitative methods, coupled with a passion for financial markets and some previous exposure to the sector. You will work closely with portfolio managers and investment analysts, helping to translate complex data into actionable insights.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Automate Reporting: Support the building and automation of investment reports and financial reports, helping to provide timely and accurate insights to portfolio managers and stakeholders.
* Support Model Development: Assist in the design, backtesting, and implementation of statistical and machine learning models for asset allocation, risk management, and return forecasting.
* Conduct Data Analysis: Perform rigorous analysis of financial time series to help model market dynamics, understand volatility patterns, and identify underlying trends.
* Assist in Signal Generation: Contribute to the research, design, and validation of predictive investment signals by working with a wide range of traditional and alternative financial data.
* Contribute to Research: Assist in researching cutting\-edge academic and industry findings in quantitative finance and machine learning.
* Support Portfolio Managers: Generate insights for Portfolio Managers through analysis of portfolio performance, risk, and performance attribution.
* Collaboration \& Communication: Work collaboratively with the team to integrate quantitative insights into the investment process.

**Requirements**

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Degree (MSc or PhD) in a quantitative discipline such as Financial Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Up to 5 years of relevant experience (including internships or academic projects) in a quantitative or data\-focused role.
* Strong proficiency in Python and its data science ecosystem (pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit\-learn, statsmodels).
* Solid understanding of financial time series modelling, including concepts related to forecasting, volatility, and non\-stationarity.
* Demonstrable experience applying machine learning techniques (e.g., Gradient Boosting, Random Forests, Clustering) to data, preferably financial.
* Experience with (or academic exposure to) building investment signals or automating data analysis and reporting.
* Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing large datasets.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with financial data providers such as Bloomberg, Refinitiv Eikon, or FactSet.
* Exposure to cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP) or big data technologies (e.g., Spark).
* An interest in deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
* Progress towards the CFA or FRM designation is a plus.

**What We offer**

* The opportunity to make a direct and meaningful impact on investment decisions at a leading firm.
* A collaborative, intellectually stimulating environment that encourages continuous learning and innovation.
* Strong mentorship and clear pathways for career progression and professional development.
* Access to extensive datasets and existing quantitative stack.

**Benefits**

* + Health Insurance, Wellness plan
	+ Fee free investments on Moneyfarm platform
	+ Incentive scheme
	+ Career development opportunities
	+ Training opportunities
	+ Regular office social events
	+ Happy and friendly culture!

* AWS Professional level certification
* Bachelor's degree, or experience in software development with object oriented language

**About the Borough**
Joining us, you get to work for not just one high performing London Borough, but two.


Kingston and Sutton councils have a number of shared services serving both authorities, with some teams and roles more focussed on one council than the other, but the majority are shared across both, meaning you get multiple opportunities to learn from a wider pool of activities and two different political bodies.


We work flexibly in both Kingston and Sutton offices, and support working at home or flexible working patterns that enable you to tailor your working and personal life. We provide the equipment and tools to enable you to work flexibly, and in return ask you to use that flexibility to be creative and ambitious in the services we deliver.


There are some really exciting things happening in both boroughs. In Sutton, we are developing the London Cancer Hub, a world leading cancer research and treatment hub that will bring together professionals from across different sectors to identify and test new treatments and therapies. Over in Kingston, we are undertaking the largest housing regeneration programme ever delivered in the borough, building new energy efficient housing that will transform some of our oldest Council owned housing. Both boroughs have publicly committed to doing what they can to tackle the climate emergency and are investing in new technologies and societal change that will help bring carbon emissions down and improve our climate impact.


You should choose Kingston and Sutton if you are looking for an opportunity that will challenge you to deliver more, support you to achieve personal ambitions, and expect you to put borough residents at the heart of what you do.


Kingston is a beautiful Royal borough with a historic setting on the banks of the Thames with excellent schools and a bustling retail centre, all surrounded by open green spaces such as Richmond Park and Bushey Park, former recreation grounds for Tudor Kings and Queens. The Council is controlled by a Liberal Democrat Administration and has a council plan “Greener, Fairer, Safer, Together”, that sets out a vision to be a vibrant, diverse and inclusive borough where residents are active, empowered, engaged and able to remain independent and resilient. The Council engages with residents through a number of forums and events through the year, and like Sutton plays a leading role in developing the South West Region of London.


Sutton is a well connected attractive part of London that has a reputation for excellent schools, green and leafy open spaces, and a history that drives a thriving heritage and culture offer through our museums and libraries. The Council is controlled by a long established Liberal Democrat Administration and has high ambitions set out in its corporate plan “Ambitious for Sutton”, that will ensure Sutton remains a great place to live, work and raise a family. The Council plays a leading role in a number of local partnerships and places great emphasis on engaging effectively with its residents, listening to local voices and making their message heard across London Government.



**About the Role and our Ideal Candidate**
The data engineer will be joining the corporate data service. You will play a key role in the delivery of the data strategy. In this role, you will:

* **Lead Platform Development:** Take a leading role in the build, and maintenance of the AWS\-based data platform, bringing together data from numerous systems.
* **Engineer Data Solutions:** Build and optimise scalable data pipelines, APIs, and ETL/ELT processes to connect operational systems with our data platforms.
* **Deliver Key Projects:** Lead complex data engineering projects, managing internal and external partners.
* **Collaborate and Innovate:** Work closely with data scientists, analysts, and service leaders to build data products and services that provide continuous insight for our staff and residents.
* **Drive Data Quality:** Work across the organisation to extract, clean, and combine data, establishing rigorous standards to make it a trusted asset for decision\-making.

**About You**


You are a collaborative and adaptable engineer who is eager to grow with our new data service. You have a passion for solving complex problems and building efficient, reliable data systems.

**You are:**

* **Skilled in Cloud services \& Data Platforms:** You possess excellent Python and SQL/NoSQL skills and have significant experience with AWS cloud services (e.g., Redshift, Athena, Lambda, S3\). You can design, build, and optimise scalable data pipelines.
* **A Proven Project Leader:** You have a track record of leading complex data engineering projects in an agile manner and delivering impactful data products and services.
* **A Clear Communicator:** You excel at explaining highly technical concepts to diverse audiences and can build strong relationships with stakeholders to foster a data\-driven culture.
* **A Champion for Data Governance:** You have a strong understanding of data security, GDPR, and data protection regulations, especially within the context of sensitive data.
* **An Innovator and Problem\-Solver:** You are passionate about learning new technologies, automating manual processes, and finding innovative solutions to improve data reliability and efficiency.
* **Dealing with complex data**: You have experience working with complex datasets and working with services to automate manual processes or make existing processing more efficient and cost effective.

**Supporting Statement**  

In your supporting statement please tell us *'What motivates you to pursue a data science role within local government? Please describe a specific project or accomplishment from your professional experience where you used data to solve a complex problem or drive a positive outcome. (250 to 350 words)'*

  


**About Us**
The new Data Service is part of a shared Digital \& IT service for the Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames and the London Borough of Sutton. Both councils have ambitious transformation programmes that depend on a more effective use of data to gain better insights and improve council services for residents. The team will also play a key role in supporting each Council’s AI and digital ambitions.


Being a new service the successful candidate(s) will have an opportunity to grow, learn and set direction.


Both Councils have data strategies with the strong backing of management and colleagues. The data strategy aims to:

* Set a data architecture and build a platform that makes it easier for the organisation to find, combine and use data.
* Establish a data governance framework to improve quality and handling so staff can have confidence in data products.
* Upskill our data analysts and council employees and recruiting data specialists.
* Select and embed new tools and technologies to improve data usage.
* Promote a more data\-driven culture at all levels in the organisation.


The role reports directly to the Head of Data.

  

We support hybrid work but this is not a completely remote working role.



**Our Offer To You**
As an organisation that values and nurtures talent, we’re committed to helping you fulfil your potential and will offer you a supportive, friendly and collaborative environment to grow and develop your career and skills. We’re constantly striving to improve our ways of working so putting your ideas across however big or small; will be fully encouraged and supported by your colleagues and our dynamic and experienced management team.


Employees have access to a wide range of benefits to enable staff to achieve a work life balance, some of which include:

* A generous annual leave entitlement of 25\-32 days, plus bank holidays (pro\-rata if part\-time working hours apply) depending on service and grade.
* Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, shared parental, adoption and dependents leave
* Three volunteering days per year in Kingston
* Hybrid working (dependent on the role)
* Flexible and agile working arrangements using Google Chromebooks
* Learning and development portal offering a range of courses
* Discounts on a range of local shops, restaurants, gyms and leisure centres
* Interest free season ticket loans
* Local Government Pension Scheme
* Bicycle loan facilities and cycle to work scheme
* Zip car scheme
* Confidential health \& wellbeing and counselling support


**Application Process**
Apply online outlining what skills, abilities and experience you can bring which makes you an ideal candidate for this role. Please refer to the requirements outlined in the job profile when completing your application and check your CV details have been uploaded correctly in the relevant sections.


We understand and recognise the benefits of using Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the workplace and are embracing AI where appropriate, to boost our productivity and streamline how we deliver our Council services efficiently; to provide the best possible outcomes for our residents and communities.  

However, we reserve the right to reject applications where it is apparent that AI\-generated content has been used in isolation and without personalised responses. At Kingston we value authenticity and are looking for individuals who can clearly demonstrate their own skills, experience and motivation for the role that they are applying for and embrace and demonstrate our STAR values.
  

Here at Kingston we have core values of Transparency and this is to be demonstrated during the application process and completion of the supporting statement and will be further tested at interview and selection stage for those who progress forward.


The closing date is given as a guide. We reserve the right to close this vacancy once a sufficient number of applications has been received, it is strongly advised that you complete and submit your application as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.


As part of our award winning Diversity Programme we anonymise all applications received to reduce conscious and unconscious bias enabling every application to be reviewed on the knowledge, skills and experience shown in your application. We encourage our interview panels to be as diverse as possible (age, cultural, neurodiverse etc.) to reduce bias where possible. We are fully committed to removing barriers and enhancing the diversity of our workforce.



**Additional Information**
We are in the process of updating our payscales in line with the pay award for NJC, Chief Officers and Chief Executives for April 2025 therefore please take this into account when viewing the salary on this position.


We are proud to be a diverse and welcoming Borough and we strive to create a workforce which reflects the community we serve, and instil a sense of belonging in our staff. We celebrate and respect differences and appreciate the value of having a diverse workforce, therefore we welcome applications from under represented groups.


To support our workers and their families we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, staff engagement forums and inclusive staff networks who help drive our diversity agenda.


We are also proud to be a disability confident employer and guarantee to interview all disabled applicants who meet the minimum essential criteria for a role. As an accredited London Living Wage Employer all our employees are guaranteed the London Living Wage regardless of their length or type of contract.


The UK has a points\-based immigration system affecting EU and Non\-EU workers and sponsorship requirements. We advise checking the GOV.UK website for right to work guidance. Sponsorship availability varies and is subject to eligibility requirements and budget limitations. As a result, we cannot guarantee sponsorship for all roles and will evaluate sponsorship requests on a case\-by\-case basis.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Data Engineer  

Job Type: Full Time, Permanent  

Working location: London, Hybrid  

Role Purpose  

At Travelex we are developing modern data services, which will be at the heart of our relationship with our customers. Our data architecture is becoming more service\-oriented and more real\-time – which creates a range of engineering problems for you to solve. Our work is fast\-paced although our team remains collaborative and flexible even when delivering fast.
As a Data Engineer, you’ll collaborate with stakeholders across the business to design and deliver new components of our data landscape. You’ll own your work end\-to\-end, from defining the approach, through coding, configuration and documentation, to go\-live. In doing so, you’ll have significant impact on how our business evolves and the freedom to shape solutions in your own way.  

Key Responsibilities  

Here are key things you’ll do as a data engineer in our team. The list isn’t complete: as a competent engineer, you’ll bring to Travelex your own ideas of what else is needed to become a world\-class data\-driven business.* Develop code, scripts and configurations as part of the development of data pipelines, data services and data transformations.
* Define data solutions, and lead all activities required when agreeing the best design (analysis, engagement, documentation).
* Take initiative to investigate whatever needs clarification during design or development.
* Learn what’s required from your solutions and negotiate the requirements to achieve clarity and simplicity.
* Learn about features, capabilities and settings of the technologies used to build the best solution.
* Brainstorm your engineering approach continuously with colleagues and partners.
* Recommend development priorities, explain pros and cons of different options, and reach agreement on the next steps if needed.
* Recommend and implements steps to test and secure your data solutions.
  

Key Requirements  

This vacancy is for someone who enjoys mixing hands\-on coding with wider problem\-solving and continuous learning. Below are key requirements from our data engineer, but you don’t need to tick every box. Success in our team is not limited to the traditional data engineering type!* Significant hands\-on experience with AWS services focused on data flow, pipelines, data transformation, storage and streaming.
* Excellent data engineering skills, for example with SQL, Python, DBT and Airflow.
* Good understanding of service\-oriented architecture; experience of exposing and consuming data via APIs, streams and webhooks.
* Experience designing scalable data models, warehouse/lakehouse architectures, and dimensional modelling for analytics.
* Confidence in coding, scripting, configuring, versioning, debugging, testing and deploying.
* Skilled in optimising queries, pipelines, and storage for cost and performance efficiency.
* Good understanding of security best practices, and experience of implementing them.
* Knowledge of data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and governance tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
* Experience setting up alerting, logging, and monitoring for data pipelines (e.g., using CloudWatch, Datadog).
* Comfortable collaborating with data scientists and analysts to productionise models or build reusable data assets.
* A track record of automating manual processes and designing systems to scale with growing data volumes.
* The ability to explain, brainstorm, present, simplify, clarify, prioritise, document, listen, negotiate and compromise.
* The curiosity to understand the business, its requirements and culture.
* Your own unique style or way of working, which will make our team diverse and original.
